agent.first_message: Commander here. Want the status, or straight to the cards?
Commander hier. Erst der Stand, oder gleich die Karten?
Командир на связи. Сначала статус или сразу карточки?

client_tools.name: fleet_status
client_tools.description: Live state of every agent pane: working, idle or blocked, and which is the commander.

client_tools.name: cards_list
client_tools.description: The open decision cards in Karl's queue, most urgent first, with options and whether a spoken confirm is needed.

client_tools.name: card_answer
client_tools.description: Record Karl's answer on one card through the queue tool. Call it as soon as he decides; for a sensitive card the first call returns an echo to read back, and you call again with the same id and word after he says confirm.

id.description: The card's full id from cards_list.

word.description: approve, hold, change, later, or one of the card's options.

note.description: What to change, or any condition Karl attached.

excerpt.description: Karl's own words for this answer, verbatim.

client_tools.name: tell
client_tools.description: Send Karl's words verbatim to an agent pane. Use pane 'commander' for the commander.

pane.description: commander, a pane name, or a pane id.

text.description: Exactly what Karl said to pass on.

client_tools.name: ask
client_tools.description: Ask an agent pane a question. Returns at once; the answer arrives later as context data, followed by a fixed '(fleet, not Karl)' message.

pane.description: commander, a pane name, or a pane id.

client_tools.name: spawn_lane
client_tools.description: Karl wants new work started. Routed to the commander, who decides how.

goal.description: What the new lane should achieve, in Karl's words.

client_tools.name: box_health
client_tools.description: Whether the DGX box is reachable and its main services are up.

client_tools.name: okr_status
client_tools.description: The objectives and key results as recorded in the repo.

client_tools.name: end_call
client_tools.description: Hang up after your closing line. Saves the call for the vault.

system_tools.name: language_detection
system_tools.description: Switch language when Karl switches between German, English and Russian.
